description: Phase 3 negative trial readout — primary endpoint missed

raw_document.title: BetaBio Reports Topline Results from Phase 3 PINNACLE Trial of BBX-204
raw_document.raw_text:
BetaBio Therapeutics (NASDAQ: BBIO) today reported topline results from its Phase 3 PINNACLE trial evaluating BBX-204 in patients with relapsed or refractory diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL).

The trial did not meet its primary endpoint of progression-free survival (PFS). The hazard ratio for PFS was 0.89 (95% CI: 0.74-1.08) with a p-value of 0.24, which did not achieve statistical significance.

Secondary endpoints:
- Overall survival (OS): HR 0.94 (p=0.61) — not significant
- Overall response rate: 31% versus 28% placebo
- Complete response rate: 18% versus 16%

Trial: NCT05123456 — Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase 3 study
853 patients enrolled

The safety profile of BBX-204 was consistent with prior studies. No new safety signals were observed.

'While we are disappointed by these results, we will conduct a thorough analysis of the data before determining next steps,' said CEO Robert Chang. BetaBio will discuss the implications for the BBX-204 program with the FDA.
